about: Black Isle out of OakScene (Ken, 2026-11-03: the thrusters, the ruins below them, the ink ejector enemies and everything at the bottom of the two big ruin stones, such as the tablet and fuel bottle: all of WhiteOak/Device-Thrusters), placed where Ken probed (2026-11-03T02:38:26.967Z: the hit at 44.464 155.313 -43.116, on a Beech bouncer seen from Hawthorn) plus ten meters on along the camera's direction. The point midway between the two big stones' bases (ThrusterShaman, WardingShaman) goes there; nothing is turned. node tools/split-scene.js splits/BlackIsleScene.json BlackIsle gets a copy of WhiteOak's FilterOnPopulate (stage Oak and beyond), so the pieces appear when they did. Its BlackIsleSceneTracker links it to OakBiome's region, as OakSceneTracker does Oak (Claude, 2026-11-03: the split had left it without one; Hawthorn has no region of its own yet).
